tasks.title: AI task creation FIX: correct Gemini v1beta REST payload key casing (functionDeclarations/systemInstruction/generationConfig/functionCall/functionResponse were snake_case -> function calling never engaged, so create_task never ran); add recurrence_end tool param

tasks.title: FIX time-remaining-today: count recurring instances and carried-over tasks against the day, plus overnight segment accounting
tasks.notes: New DayAccounting engine (data/DayAccounting.kt) is the single source of truth for per-day minute occupancy. TaskRepository.getAllocatedMinutesToday + getRemainingMinutesToday now delegate to it, and TaskViewModel.allocatedMinutesToday + remainingMinutesToday do too. All task categories now count: one-off timed, recurring templates occurring today, generated recurring instances (even with stale past fixedTime), carried-over unfinished tasks, and pre-midnight segments of overnight tasks. TaskViewModel.tasks TODAY/WEEK/MONTH/YEAR filters + addTask/saveEdit + TaskAgentTools create/update also use DayAccounting.touchesDay/occursOnDay so overnight and carried-over tasks show on the correct day.

tasks.title: NEW overnight/cross-midnight tasks: single logical task split into two linked per-day segments (one-off + recurring fixed-time); day accounting, due-now pinning, day/week/month/year views safe
tasks.notes: Overnight/cross-midnight tasks modeled as ONE logical task whose span (fixedTime .. fixedTime+duration) can cross midnight. DayAccounting.spanOf/crossesMidnight/segmentsOnDay split the span into per-day segments: pre-midnight portion counts on the start day, post-midnight on the next. Validations (TaskViewModel.addTask/saveEdit, TaskAgentTools create/update) now charge only the TODAY segment against today's remaining time. sweepMissed and stale due-now clearing are span-aware (task not missed/pin-cleared while its span still runs past midnight). Day/week/month/year views use DayAccounting.touchesDay so each day shows the task segment. One entry/one completion/one edit preserved. TaskListScreen shows the linked span label (e.g. '20:00 → 03:00 +1d').

tasks.title: FIX Unfinished view retention: auto-delete recurring (and all) unfinished entries after configurable retention period, same as Completed
tasks.notes: Unfinished (missed) tasks — including recurring instances — now expire under the SAME configurable retention period as Completed. tasks.title: Background Reliability for AI Requests: make AgentOrchestrator application-scoped singleton with Process/App CoroutineScope and WakeLock so in-flight requests complete when backgrounded
tasks.notes: FIXED Background Reliability for In-Progress AI Requests: Converted AgentOrchestrator to an application-scoped singleton backed by an independent CoroutineScope(SupervisorJob() + Dispatchers.IO); protected request execution with a 3-minute CPU WakeLock (added android.permission.WAKE_LOCK); replaced composable-tied coroutine launches in ChatPanel with orchestrator.submit() and orchestrator.submitAudio(). When the user minimizes or backgrounds the app or closes the chat sheet mid-request, execution continues uninterrupted to completion in the background and posts a notification summary upon finish.

tasks.title: AI High-Usage Handling: implement retry with exponential backoff on 429/503/RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED errors in GeminiClient, distinguishing temporary load from invalid keys
tasks.notes: FIXED AI High-Usage Handling: Updated GeminiClient to classify responses (HTTP 429, 503, 500, 502, 504 and RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED / rate limit / unavailable error payloads) as temporary high load rather than invalid keys; implemented exponential backoff retries with jitter and Retry-After header parsing (up to 4 attempts); introduced HighUsageExhaustedException and InvalidApiKeyException. In AgentOrchestrator, high-load errors surface a distinct high-usage message without false apiKeysFailed notifications or key invalidation alerts.
